captions.detailed: A wide-angle porro-prism field binocular featuring two offset objective tubes and two central eyepiece tubes. The body consists of several blocky, black-finished housing segments that connect the offset objective lenses to the narrower eyepiece assemblies. The eyepieces terminate in black circular cups with light blue circular lenses, while the main objective barrels are solid black cylinders. The central focus wheel and the diopter ring on the right eyepiece are designed to rotate continuously.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a wide-angle porro-prism binocular with offset objective and eyepiece tubes. The model should feature dark blocky prism housings, cylindrical objective barrels, and dual eyepiece tubes with light blue lenses, incorporating continuous rotational joints for the central focus mechanism and the right eye diopter ring.
captions.factory: The code defines an ArticulatedObject representing the binocular. It models the main central body using boxes and cylinders for the prism housings and objective barrels. It then constructs the left and right eyepiece tubes as cylindrical parts offset from the center. Finally, it defines the necessary continuous and fixed articulations to connect the eyepieces, central focus wheel, and objective assemblies to the main body.
